selected_path: Separate binary-treatment IRM ATE worker; panel and other score families separately qualified.
input: Explicit covariate allowlist excluding post-treatment and information-clock leakage.
Stable row IDs, units, outcome/treatment definitions and target population.
Fixed splits and out-of-fold external prediction lineage; finite shapes and matching observation/repetition order.
Raw and processed propensity, exact clipping/calibration/normalization choices and weight target.
output: Declared ATE/ATTE/weighted target; coefficient and full uncertainty representation.
Nuisance predictions, fold IDs, score components, diagnostics, failures and sensitivity assumptions.
refusal: Reject incompatible IV or nonbinary/multiple treatments for IRM; route only after identification review.
Do not map first-adoption panel groups to arbitrary sequential action trajectories.
Do not interpret clipping as positivity evidence or cluster columns as arbitrary temporal covariance.
oracle: Independent fixed-nuisance score reference with deliberately varied propensity, weighting and covariate clocks.
Matched native comparison only after exact environment and delegate inspection; include all failures and complete covariance.
